name: The Innocent Mother...
source:
This game tells the story of an innocent and well-meaning 40 year old woman who moves to another country and finds it difficult to adapt to a new place, new habits, new friends and new problems.

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/Spies]Patreon[/url]]

Further development of the game has been abandoned.
translation:
本作讲述一名善良天真的40岁女性移居他国后，难以适应新地方、新习惯、新朋友与新问题的故事。

[据[url=https://www.patreon.com/Spies]Patreon[/url]编辑]

本作已停止继续开发。
